newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SOCCER-AUSTRIAN KEEPER KONSEL POISED FOR ROMA MOVE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AUSTRIAN KEEPER KONSEL POISED FOR ROMA MOVE.

text.p: Rapid Vienna goalkeeper Michael Konsel is poised to sign a two-year deal with AS Roma on Monday, the Austrian news agency APA reported on Sunday.
"There is a 90 percent chance that Konsel will sign for Roma," Konsel's lawyer Skender Fani told APA.
Fani said the two clubs had come to an agreement and that he would be travelling to Rome with Konsel on Monday.
Rapid manager Werner Kuhn told APA, Roma would pay 9.05 million schillings ($700,000) for the 35-year-old, the curent Austrian international keeper.
Rapid originally demanded 10 million schillings ($811,000) from Roma if Konsel signed for them now.
"The sooner Konsel is needed, the more expensive he becomes," Kuhn said on Friday.
But Kuhn said his club would lower the fee to four million schillings ($324,000) if Konsel served three months notice.
